profiles.label: Primary and secondary education
profiles.area_defined: All school buildings; include outdoor courtyards only when the source ties instruction or evacuation to that area.
profiles.day_occurrence: Open during school or childcare sessions.
profiles.night_occurrence: Usually closed, with possible staff, maintenance, janitorial, or security presence.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for elementary schools, primary schools, middle schools, high schools, secondary schools, preschools, daycare facilities, and childcare centers. Good evidence includes students, children, pupils, teachers, or staff physically present, inside, evacuated, rescued, or recorded as attending on a bounded date. Treat enrollment, directory, map, and generic school profile pages as context only.
preferred_source_types: official emergency or public-safety incident report
official school district or school incident announcement
context_only_source_types: generic school profile page without a count-bearing event or incident
enrollment, capacity, or annual statistics page
social media repost without an original authoritative source

profiles.label: University and college
profiles.area_defined: Academic buildings only unless the source identifies another specific campus facility; exclude dormitories, dining halls, recreation centers, and libraries unless separately targeted.
profiles.day_occurrence: Open during class, laboratory, training, and administrative periods.
profiles.night_occurrence: Some facilities may remain accessible to fewer students, faculty, staff, maintenance, janitorial, or security personnel.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for universities, colleges, vocational schools, training centers, lecture halls, laboratories, and academic campus buildings. Good evidence includes students, faculty, staff, trainees, or visitors physically present, inside, evacuated, rescued, or recorded as attending a bounded class, event, incident, or operating period. Treat enrollment, rankings, directory, and generic campus pages as context only.
preferred_source_types: official emergency or public-safety incident report
official dated attendance or event report
context_only_source_types: generic campus profile page without a count-bearing event or incident
enrollment, capacity, ranking, or statistics page
social media repost without an original authoritative source

profiles.label: University library
profiles.area_defined: All areas of the library; exclude coffee shops or other facilities inside the library unless the count is explicitly tied to the library occupancy.
profiles.day_occurrence: Open to students, faculty, staff, visitors, and library employees.
profiles.night_occurrence: Open or closed depending on facility hours, with possible reduced visitors, staff, maintenance, janitorial, or security personnel.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for university libraries and study halls inside libraries. Good evidence includes students, visitors, employees, faculty, or staff present, evacuated, checked in, or attending a bounded library event. Treat library capacity, collection size, annual visitors, and directory pages as context only.
